evidence.observation: First failure from 10.0.5.20 (VULNSCAN01) at 14:10:00Z; the asset inventory says this host is the authorised scanner.
Failures against many different accounts again, one per ~20 seconds, matching the spray shape rather than a scan of one host.
Activity continues to 14:20:53Z, outside change CHG-1042 whose window was 10:00-10:30Z; no approved change covers this time.

rationale: The scanner address is trusted only during its approved change window. The same source spraying accounts at 14:10Z has no change ticket, so the host may be compromised or misused. Do not extend the morning exception to it.
next_steps: Ask secops whether any scan was scheduled at 14:10Z
Review the scanner service account svc-scanner for misuse
